q: How many radio stations are in GTA IV?
a: GTA IV has 19 radio stations, 16 music and three talk, with a 20th custom station, Independence FM, on PC. Episodes from Liberty City adds three exclusive stations with 48 songs.

q: Who are the DJs on GTA IV radio?
a: Per Wikipedia and Grand Theft Wiki, hosts include Iggy Pop (Liberty Rock Radio), Karl Lagerfeld (K109), Juliette Lewis (Radio Broker), DJ Premier (The Classics 104.1), Daddy Yankee (San Juan Sounds) and Femi Kuti (IF99). The Lost and Damned added shows from Funkmaster Flex, Statik Selektah and Max Cavalera.

q: Who are the DJs on GTA 5 radio stations?
a: Launch hosts include Kenny Loggins (Los Santos Rock Radio), Cara Delevingne (Non-Stop-Pop FM), Pam Grier (The Lowdown 91.1), Bootsy Collins (Space 103.2), Flying Lotus (FlyLo FM), Soulwax (Soulwax FM) and Gilles Peterson (Worldwide FM). Sources disagree on the East Los FM host.

q: How many songs are on the GTA 5 radio?
a: Rockstar's Ivan Pavlovich gave 240 licensed songs on 15 music stations at the 2013 launch. The 2014 next-gen edition added about 165 more per the GTA wiki, and GTA Online updates have added hundreds since, including over 250 in the 2020 Cayo Perico Heist.

q: Why were songs removed from GTA IV?
a: Music licenses expired. From April 26, 2018, licensed songs were patched out of GTA IV and its episodes, many from Vladivostok FM, and Vice reported almost 100 missing from the 2020 Steam Complete Edition.

q: What radio stations were added in GTA Online and when?
a: blonded Los Santos (2017), Los Santos Underground Radio (2018), iFruit Radio (2019), Kult FM, Still Slipping Los Santos and The Music Locker (2020), and the Media Player and MOTOMAMI Los Santos (2021). No whole new station has been found since December 2021.

q: What radio stations are in GTA Chinatown Wars?
a: Per the GTA wiki, the DS version has five stations named after producers (Deadmau5, Alchemist, Truth & Soul, Ticklah, Prairie Cartel), and the PSP version adds six more. A 2009 WorthPlaying report instead says the game reused GTA IV station names, so the sources disagree.
